title: Enterololin: AI helps clarify an antibiotic and its mechanism
summary: An AI screen of over 10,000 molecules identified enterololin, and DiffDock predicted its binding to LolCDE within minutes, confirmed by resistant E. coli mutants, RNA-seq, and CRISPR. The mechanism was clarified in about six months versus 18–24 with traditional methods. In mice, in Crohn's-like inflammation models, healing was faster than with vancomycin. Early stage; no human testing.

evidence.tested: Enterololin was tested in mouse Crohn's-like inflammation models against vancomycin, with resistant mutant sequencing, RNA-seq and CRISPR knockdown used to clarify its mechanism.
evidence.unknown: The source states it is early-stage development, no human data are reported, and clinical trials are not yet started.
evidence.ai_role: DiffDock predicted binding of enterololin to the LolCDE complex within minutes, guiding lab experiments on the mechanism.
